assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent PNG sprite for a small isometric fantasy tower defense game, For the Fortress!, Alliance faction.
Create ONE standalone compact royal fortress building WITHOUT any person. Thick dark clean outlines, chunky minimal cartoon shapes, broad two-tone cel shading, readable at 90 pixels wide. Match the cartoon rendering and palette depth of the supplied character reference; the reference is style only, do not draw that character or a weapon.
Three-quarter isometric view from above, front entrance facing lower-left, tall compact silhouette. Pale grey stone walls, blue conical side-tower roofs, restrained gold trims, heavy wooden gate. Symmetric overall mass with two short side turrets and a slightly higher central tower. The central tower has an OPEN FLAT TOP BATTLEMENT PLATFORM, centered and clearly visible, large enough for a separate king sprite to stand on it later. Side roofs must stay below that platform. No central spire or roof over this standing area. Simplified big blocks, few windows, no micro-detail.
Entire building visible with empty margins, centered, no cropping. Genuine transparent background. No ground tile, no grass, no scenery, no cast shadow, no banners or flags, no characters, no text, no UI, no watermark, no logo, no copyrighted franchise insignia. No photorealism or 3D render. Original design.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent PNG isometric fortress sprite for For the Fortress!, HORDE faction.
Create ONE standalone compact fortress WITHOUT any person. Style reference 1 is a cartoon orc: use its thick dark clean outlines, chunky minimal forms and broad cel shading. Reference 2 is the Alliance fortress: match its camera angle, scale and compact three-tower composition, but create the Horde's own architecture and colors, not a recolor.
Three-quarter isometric view from above, front gate facing lower-left. Dark timber, warm brown logs, iron bands and rivets, deep red side-tower roofs, a few big ivory tusk supports, restrained spikes. Stout strong readable silhouette, not horror. Two shorter side watchtowers flank a taller central bastion. Central bastion has an OPEN FLAT TOP PLATFORM visible from above, with a low crenellated parapet and clear center for a separate orc king sprite to stand later. No central roof, pole or spike occupying that center. No flag poles or flags. Big simple blocks and panels readable at 90 pixels wide; avoid tiny clutter.
Entire structure visible with empty margins, centered. Genuine transparent background, no ground tile, no scenery, no cast shadow, no characters, no writing, no UI, no watermark or logo. Original fantasy design with no copyrighted franchise symbols. Clean 2D cartoon sprite, not 3D or photorealistic.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D SPRITE SHEET for an original Alliance KING standing on top of a small cartoon fortress in For the Fortress!.
One wide horizontal row of EXACTLY FOUR separate full-body poses of THE SAME HUMAN KING. Four equal cells, consistent camera, body scale, costume, head and crown in every cell; align feet to same baseline. Huge clear empty transparent gaps between poses; nothing overlapping adjacent cells; no cropping.
Character design: friendly stern middle-aged human sovereign with short grey beard and expressive brows, large head in chunky chibi fantasy proportions, compact body, blue-and-cream royal coat and short blue cape, broad gold trim, simple gold crown with one blue gem, brown boots, empty hands. NO weapon or staff, no throne. Crown prominent so he reads as a king at 32 pixels tall. ORIGINAL character, not any existing franchise character. Render exactly in the simple thick dark outlined, broad cel-shaded cartoon style of the reference unit. Reference is style only, do not draw a dwarf or a crossbow.
All four poses face three-quarter toward the viewer's lower-left, seen slightly from above like an isometric game sprite:
CELL 1 at far left: calm upright idle, hands relaxed at belt.
CELL 2: encouraging his defenders, one empty hand raised in a firm rallying gesture, confident expression.
CELL 3: brief non-gory startled hurt flinch, shoulders hunched, eyes squeezed, arms drawn toward chest, crown stays on head.
CELL 4 at far right: saddened defeat, head bowed and shoulders slumped, still standing and alive, crown still on head.
Solid readable silhouettes, few large details, no floating effects, no drawn shadow or ground, no backdrop. Genuine transparent background. NO text, numbers, UI, watermark, logo, cell borders or labels. Keep every crown, boot and hand inside its own cell.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D SPRITE SHEET for an original HORDE ORC KING for For the Fortress!, standing atop a small fortress.
Create one wide horizontal row of EXACTLY FOUR separate full-body poses of THE SAME ORC SOVEREIGN, matching the four-pose layout, camera and character scale of reference 2. Reference 1 supplies the orc species and thick-outlined cel-shaded cartoon style; reference 2 supplies the pose-sheet format only. Do not redraw the human king or the shaman.
Character: masculine green-skinned orc royal ruler, large head and broad compact body, yellow eyes, two big lower tusks, stern expressive face, short dark hair. Distinctive simple jagged iron crown with one red gem, dark leather royal coat, broad iron shoulder guards, a short deep red cape with ivory fur collar, brown boots, empty hands. Prominent crown and face readable at 32 pixels high. No axe, staff, throne or magical effect. Original character; no existing franchise hero, crest or logo.
Four equal cells, entire body with crown and feet inside each cell, large transparent gaps, aligned foot baseline, consistent proportions/costume/colors across poses. Three-quarter facing viewer's lower-left, seen slightly from above.
Cell 1 left: upright calm idle, hands resting at belt.
Cell 2: encouraging defenders with one raised empty fist, confident rallying expression.
Cell 3: non-gory startled hurt flinch, hunched shoulders, eyes squeezed, arms drawn inward, crown remains on head.
Cell 4 right: bowed head and slumped shoulders after defeat, still standing and alive.
Minimal chunky silhouette, broad two-tone cel shading, thick dark outlines. Genuine transparent background. No ground, shadows, scenery, text, numbers, labels, UI, watermark, cell borders, weapons or additional figures.
